brief:
Pro-Palestinian demonstrators gathered in Ljubljana to protest the opening of Israel's first resident embassy in Slovenia, Al Jazeera English reported. The protesters assembled in the capital as the diplomatic mission formally inaugurated operations, marking a new phase in Israeli-Slovenian relations.

The establishment of a permanent residential embassy represents a significant expansion of Israel's diplomatic footprint in Central Europe. Slovenia's decision to host the mission came amid wider regional shifts in diplomatic ties with Israel, though the move drew organized opposition from Palestinian solidarity activists. The demonstration underscored ongoing tensions over Palestinian statehood and Israeli governance that continue to animate public sentiment across Europe.
dek: Pro-Palestinian protesters gathered in Slovenia’s capital to oppose the opening of Israel’s first resident embassy.
title: Pro-Palestinian protesters oppose Israel embassy opening in Slovenia
